# Explicit allowlist for tracked files under a CHIA runtime-output directory
# (see scan-phi-dua.sh's DUA_ARTIFACT_DIRS check). Every path here was
# individually verified, not assumed:
#
# chia_capacity/*: content shows facility_id = "FAC_001" etc., which is
#   structurally impossible from a real query (the observed-mode SQL selects
#   the real id_org_site column) and exactly matches
#   fixture_chia_hospital_volume()'s hardcoded sprintf("FAC_%03d", 1:45).
#   Confirmed synthetic.
#
# chia_travel/chia_urps_inpatient_observed_travel_shares_*: generated by
#   build_chia_surgical_travel_kernel(mock_routes, ...) in
#   scripts/chia/build_chia_surgical_travel_kernel.R, where mock_routes is a
#   hardcoded 4-row fake ZIP-pair dataset. Never queries the real database.
#   Confirmed not derived from real CHIA data (the function's own name says
#   "observed", which is misleading -- the input was mock, not a DB query).
#
# 480 sibling files across chia_inpatient, chia_revenue_setting,
# chia_travel/chia_urps_inpatient_travel_weights_*, and chia_validation were
# NOT added here: chia_revenue_setting was confirmed real (its generator has
# no synthetic code path at all, and content shows non-formulaic single-
# patient cells); the rest could not be ruled real from available evidence
# and were removed rather than allowlisted. See the session record for the
# full classification.
#
# A NEW file appearing in a CHIA runtime-output directory that is not listed
# here is exactly what this gate exists to catch -- do not add a path
# without individually verifying it the same way, and do not add a whole
# directory or a wildcard.
